description:
FIXED (bcc1ac3d0, re-audited PASS 2026-07-03 after one FAIL-and-rework cycle). Transport plan completeness is now order-independent BY CONSTRUCTION; sorted_executable_waits and its display-render key are DELETED.

MECHANISM (two coverage channels closing the discovery/invalidation split):
(1) SESSION CHANNEL — consulted-facts ledger: ClosureConsultLedger.executables joins every membership-influencing session read during a closure solve; record_transport_closure_consult builds the reverse index (PullSession::transport_closure_consult_dependents) that invalidate_transport_products walks transitively (borrowed, seen-guarded, no per-step clone), artifact-invalidating every reached node (walk OWNS artifact invalidation; the old redundant explicit calls collapsed).
(2) WORLD CHANNEL — read-time revision snapshot: first-read-wins revisions of ActivationAnalyzed/LoweredBody/CallSiteSummary/ReturnType captured into SolvedTransportClosure::consumed_fact_revisions (unwrap_or(0) sentinel proven collision-free: FactSlot revisions start at 1); displace_covering_solve_if_stale validates at the top of BOTH produce entry points before any cached early-return. LoweredBody classified as MEMBERSHIP-influencing (decides the need component of member keys via executable_callsite_needs). Exemptions stated inline at the seam with reasons (interned identities; OutgoingInputEdges presence probe; projection-phase callsite_summary subsumed by collect's snapshot; session-local closure id). MUST-form maintenance obligation comment at the solve seam.
(3) TransportShapeFact::AbsentForClosure(closure_id) — no terminal absent verdict remains.

PROOF: contract test compiler2_transport_consult_ledger_displaces_co_members_on_demand_movement mutation-verified INDEPENDENTLY by two auditors (ledger no-op'd: red 5/5; walk severed: red 5/5; real: green). The original wait-order permutation test was proven decoration (green under all mutations) and deleted. Matrix failure-set INVARIANCE proven across parent/naked-deleted/fixed (the honest fact; the original 21/24-failure red-baseline claim did not reproduce — extras were 3s-timeout load flakes, misattributed). Post-fold A/B in clean worktrees: HEAD 307/19/60 in ~50s vs pre-fold 307/19/60 in ~40s, failure sets byte-identical. Lib 1151/0/24 zero warnings.

KNOWN GAP (ticketed, fz-go4.18.28.15): the world-channel freshness gate has ZERO test coverage — fully neutering displace_covering_solve_if_stale passes lib+matrix unchanged. Mechanism mirrors the DemandFactsCache discipline (well-argued, untested).
RELATED (pre-existing, ticketed): consult ledger is monotone/dense per session (fz-go4.18.28.13); settle_demand_cone interned-Ty sort key (fz-go4.18.28.14); expand walk ?-early-return fragility (fz-go4.18.35). Ord sweep done: remaining transport sorts are final-packaging only.
COORDINATION NOTE: on this machine the matrix takes ~10x longer inside the long-lived coordinator checkout than in a fresh worktree (same commit, same command) — unexplained environment artifact; time matrix runs in clean worktrees.
title: Transport plan completeness is pull-wait-order dependent (schedule-protected path dependence)
